name: Anantara Bazaruto Island Resort
positioning: Fully inclusive beach-villa resort on Bazaruto Island, 30 km off the Mozambique mainland, where sand dunes meet the ocean
best_for: Couples and families who want beach villas with ocean-view plunge pools
Travelers drawn to diving, snorkelling, sailing, dolphins and whale watching

facts.text: Bazaruto Island, called the Island of the Mist, lies 30 km off the Mozambique mainland.
On the island, rolling sand dunes run down into clear azure ocean.
Beach Villas have direct beach access.
The Two-Bedroom Sea View Pool Villas are aimed at families, with indoor and poolside dining and lounging overlooking the ocean.
Activities include diving, sailing, snorkelling and deep-sea fishing.
The resort has an Anantara Spa.
The resort has a fitness centre with cardio and weight equipment.
The resort is a fully inclusive holiday destination.
Spice Spoons lets guests explore the culinary culture of Mozambique.
A helicopter flight from Vilankulos international airport to the island takes about 15 minutes.
The resort won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2019, 2022 and 2024.

highlights.text: Guests can experience the annual humpback whale migration from July to September.
Beach Pool Villas have a veranda with sun loungers, a plunge pool overlooking the ocean and a tropical outdoor shower.
The resort offers sunset dune boarding.
The resort has a private airstrip and helipad.

considerations.text: On the boat transfer, guests walk through the water to reach the vessel because there is no pier or marina.
The island lies 30 km off the mainland, so arrival is by boat or helicopter rather than by road.
Humpback whale season is limited to July to September.
